title: Tide and Promise
author: Sable Underhill
blurb: Odile Galloway, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, keeps love in the past tense where it belongs. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
